reviews.title: Great Hi-Rez displays, perfect for my work from home setup.
reviews.comment: My first 4k desktop displays. 2x32" inches. Samsung reputation lives on. Big bright clear. Cheaper as a returned unit. No issues at all, no scuffs, can't tell from brand new. Using two of these with my work laptop, desktop. For this job, size and resolution are what matters for primary display, on 2nd display, have equivalent to 4 smaller 1080 display windows open, Email, Teams files etc.
reviews.author: Souliere

reviews.title: It works is all I can say.
reviews.comment: It works. Though maybe it had a remote, but not. Not the best for turning on and off.
reviews.author: Tim

reviews.title: Clear screen with high resolution
reviews.comment: This monitor is just what I needed with my new computer capable of handling the 4k video from my drones, and looks great when editing photos and video.  The features are great for the price.
reviews.author: M. Burke

reviews.title: Okay, not great.
reviews.comment: Ordered this montior not too long ago when I purchased a different LG 4k monitor of the same size at the same time. This monitor was far inferior. The color quality isn't great, the brightness isn't great, the stand isn't adjustable, and despite being 4k, the text wasn't as clear on the monitor as it was on my other that I compared it to.
reviews.author: aquaman123

reviews.title: Stand: Is not hight adjustable
reviews.comment:
Resolution and colors: Just ok
Cables: Didn’t come with HDMI cable
Menu: hard to navigate on the back of the display
Stand: Is not hight adjustable. This makes the display very high and fixed. You can only tilt forward and backward. Not swiveling.
reviews.author: AL
